# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated from apps/web/src/keymap.ts by `pnpm docs:keyboard`. Do not edit. -->

Every keyboard shortcut in rooster. Press ? in the app to see them at any time; this page is generated from the same list.

- ⌘ on a Mac is Ctrl on Windows and Linux, and ⌥ is Alt.
- ⇥ (Tab) before a key is a Tab chord: hold Tab and press the key. Chords also work while you edit a title.
- Two keys in a row, such as G then M, are pressed one after the other, within a second.

## Navigate

| Action | Mac | Windows and Linux |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Previous row | <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>K</kbd> | <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>K</kbd> |
| Next row | <kbd>↓</kbd> / <kbd>J</kbd> | <kbd>↓</kbd> / <kbd>J</kbd> |
| Extend selection up | <kbd>⇧↑</kbd> | <kbd>Shift+↑</kbd> |
| Extend selection down | <kbd>⇧↓</kbd> | <kbd>Shift+↓</kbd> |
| First row | <kbd>Home</kbd> | <kbd>Home</kbd> |
| Last row | <kbd>End</kbd> | <kbd>End</kbd> |
| Select group, then all | <kbd>⌘A</kbd> | <kbd>Ctrl+A</kbd> |
| Add to or remove from selection | <kbd>X</kbd> | <kbd>X</kbd> |
| Collapse group or parent task | <kbd>←</kbd> | <kbd>←</kbd> |
| Expand group or parent task | <kbd>→</kbd> | <kbd>→</kbd> |
| Show or hide completed | <kbd>⇧H</kbd> | <kbd>Shift+H</kbd> |
| Stop editing, then clear the selection | <kbd>Esc</kbd> | <kbd>Esc</kbd> |
